cell.configurationSource: disposable home and project created for this inspection

method.environment: home, profile, application-data, temporary and client configuration directories redirected to empty disposable directories; updater, telemetry and non-essential traffic disabled
method.server: a local stub that answers initialize, ping and tools/list only

observations.setup: claude mcp add with the default scope
observations.observed: The server is written to the client state file in the home directory, keyed by the project path. A new empty home lists no server for the same project.
observations.consequence: Configuration added this way does not survive a session whose home is recreated.

observations.setup: A project .mcp.json, then a second empty home with nothing reapplied
observations.observed: The server is listed from project scope in both homes.
observations.consequence: Project scope is the persistent location when the project directory survives and the home does not.

observations.observed: The listing reports the server as pending approval. With enabledMcpjsonServers naming it, or enableAllProjectMcpServers true, in the user-level settings file the listing reports it connected.
observations.consequence: Approval of a project server is user-level state and is not carried by the project directory.

observations.setup: enabledMcpjsonServers naming the server in the project's .claude/settings.json, and separately in .claude/settings.local.json, each with an empty home
observations.observed: The listing still reports pending approval.
observations.consequence: No project-scope setting was shown to carry approval. Whether an interactive or headless session treats these files differently was not observed.

observations.setup: The same server name at local scope and project scope
observations.observed: The local-scope definition is the effective one.
observations.consequence: A stale local definition can mask a project definition of the same name.

observations.observed: Not present on the inspected host.

demonstratedRequirement: Deliver the selected server through project scope rather than the client's default local scope.

remedy.recipe: project-scope .mcp.json entry through the existing generic config.entries operation
notEmitted: A project settings recipe for approval: not shown to take effect.
A user-level approval recipe: user-level state is lost with the home it lives in, so it does not address the demonstrated loss.

open: Approval of the project server in a fresh home remains a native-acceptance gate; an administrator-managed setting is the administrator's decision, not a Catalog recipe.
No session was started: instruction loading, tool discovery inside a session and the read-only query are unobserved.
User scope (--scope user) was not inspected.

Read from source, not run: the reviewed @aihq/core@1.0.0-dev.33 verifier stages a fixed permission file that approves and permits only its own bundled fixture server and tools, so a supplied bundle with other names needs a Core change before native acceptance.
